# Polymarket.Net v5.0.0 Full LLM Context

This documentation targets **Polymarket.Net v5.0.0** for C#/.NET prediction markets
and perpetual futures. It uses CryptoExchange.Net 13.2.3 and CryptoExchange.Net.Web3
13.0.0. Targets: netstandard2.0, netstandard2.1, net8.0, net9.0, net10.0. Native AOT
is supported on compatible targets.

## Installation

```bash
dotnet add package Polymarket.Net --version 5.0.0
```

## Code generation rules

- Use `PolymarketRestClient` / `PolymarketSocketClient`; do not write raw HTTP or manual signatures.
- Reuse clients or use DI. Avoid `.Result` / `.Wait()`.
- Check `.Success` before `.Data`. REST returns `HttpResult<T>` / `HttpResult`; subscriptions return `WebSocketResult<UpdateSubscription>`.
- Perps socket trading/account operations return `QueryResult<T>` / `QueryResult`.
- Prediction orders need both outer `.Success` and payload `.Data.Success` checks. Perps single-order rejection is an outer failure; payloads have `Status`, `Error` and numeric `OrderId`.
- Perps batch REST placement returns per-order `CallResult<PolymarketPerpOrderResult>` entries. Check both the outer result and each entry before reading data.
- Prediction orders use token/position ids and `TimeInForce`; concrete Perps methods use numeric instrument ids and `PerpTimeInForce`.
- `PredictionApi.ExchangeData.GetMarketsAsync()` now returns a Gamma market array. Do not pass the former CLOB cursor or read `.Data.Data` for this method.
- V1 prediction markets use `ClobTokenIds`; V2 markets use `PositionIds` and `marketVersion: 2` for orders.
- `EthKey` from `CryptoExchange.Net.Web3` replaces private key string arguments in wallet credentials. Credential properties are `PredictionL1`, `PredictionL2`, `Perps`.
- `PerpsApi.SharedApi` exists on REST and socket clients; `PredictionApi.SharedApi` does not. Do not invent `SpotApi`, `FuturesApi`, `GeneralApi`, or `SharedClient`.
- Store every successful subscription and unsubscribe on shutdown and partial failure.
- Inspect interfaces for exact overloads rather than inventing method names or pagination.


## How to use

The REST and WebSocket clients expose two API branches:

|API|REST members|WebSocket members|
|--|--|--|
|Prediction markets|`PredictionApi.ExchangeData`, `.Account`, `.Trading`|`PredictionApi`|
|Perpetual futures|`PerpsApi.ExchangeData`, `.Account`, `.Trading`|`PerpsApi.ExchangeData`, `.Account`, `.Trading`|

When migrating from the previous structure, replace `ClobApi` with `PredictionApi`.
Gamma market/event/search methods now live under `PredictionApi.ExchangeData`;
Data API position methods live under `PredictionApi.Trading`.

### Prediction market data

```csharp
using Polymarket.Net.Clients;

using var restClient = new PolymarketRestClient();
var markets = await restClient.PredictionApi.ExchangeData.GetMarketsAsync(closed: false, limit: 5);
if (!markets.Success)
{
    Console.WriteLine(markets.Error);
    return;
}

var firstMarket = markets.Data.FirstOrDefault();
// V1 markets use CLOB token ids; V2 markets use position ids.
var tokenIds = firstMarket?.Version == "v2" ? firstMarket.PositionIds : firstMarket?.ClobTokenIds;
if (tokenIds == null || tokenIds.Length == 0)
    return;

var books = await restClient.PredictionApi.ExchangeData.GetOrderBooksAsync(tokenIds);
if (!books.Success)
{
    Console.WriteLine(books.Error);
    return;
}

Console.WriteLine($"Loaded {books.Data.Length} order books.");
```

### Prediction authentication and orders

Prediction authentication has two levels. L1 uses a wallet key to create or derive
L2 credentials. L2 uses an API key, secret and passphrase for private CLOB endpoints.
Order placement also needs the L1 wallet key to sign orders.

Construct wallet keys with `new EthKey(privateKey: "PRIVATE_KEY")`. Choose the
`SignType` that matches the account:

|Sign type|Account|Address supplied to `WithL1`|
|--|--|--|
|`SignType.Poly1271`|Poly1271 wallet|Polymarket deposit address|
|`SignType.Email`|Email/Magic wallet|Polymarket funding address|
|`SignType.Proxy`|Browser wallet proxy|Polymarket funding address|
|`SignType.EOA`|Externally owned account|Polymarket funding address when required by the account|

```csharp
using var restClient = new PolymarketRestClient(options =>
{
    options.ApiCredentials = new PolymarketCredentials().WithL1(
        SignType.Poly1271,
        new EthKey(privateKey: "PRIVATE_KEY"),
        "POLYMARKET_DEPOSIT_ADDRESS");
});

var credentials = await restClient.PredictionApi.Account.GetOrCreateApiCredentialsAsync();
if (!credentials.Success)
{
    Console.WriteLine(credentials.Error);
    return;
}
restClient.UpdateL2Credentials(credentials.Data);

// Buy 50 shares at $0.10 each ($5 before fees).
// Use ClobTokenIds for V1 markets, or PositionIds with marketVersion: 2 for V2.
var order = await restClient.PredictionApi.Trading.PlaceOrderAsync(
    tokenId: "TOKEN_ID",
    side: OrderSide.Buy,
    orderType: OrderType.Limit,
    quantity: 50m,
    price: 0.1m,
    marketVersion: 1);
if (!order.Success)
{
    Console.WriteLine(order.Error);
    return;
}
if (!order.Data.Success)
{
    Console.WriteLine(order.Data.Error);
    return;
}
Console.WriteLine(order.Data.OrderId);
```

If L2 credentials are already available, configure both levels directly:

```csharp
using CryptoExchange.Net.Web3;
using Polymarket.Net;
using Polymarket.Net.Enums;

var credentials = new PolymarketCredentials()
    .WithL1(SignType.Poly1271, new EthKey(privateKey: "PRIVATE_KEY"), "POLYMARKET_DEPOSIT_ADDRESS")
    .WithL2("L2_API_KEY", "L2_API_SECRET", "L2_API_PASSPHRASE");
```

### Prediction WebSocket subscriptions

```csharp
var socketClient = new PolymarketSocketClient();
var subscription = await socketClient.PredictionApi.SubscribeToTokenUpdatesAsync(
    new[] { "TOKEN_ID" },
    onBookUpdate: update => Console.WriteLine($"Book update: {update.Data}"),
    onBestBidAskUpdate: update => Console.WriteLine($"Best bid/ask: {update.Data}"));
if (!subscription.Success)
{
    Console.WriteLine(subscription.Error);
    return;
}
Console.ReadLine();
await socketClient.UnsubscribeAsync(subscription.Data);
```

For user order/trade subscriptions, configure prediction L2 credentials on the socket client. `UpdateL2Credentials` is available on both clients.

### Perpetual futures market data

Perps calls use symbol ids discovered through `GetSymbolsAsync()`. Conversion is also available via `restClient.PerpsApi.GetSymbolIdByName` and `GetSymbolNameById` after having called `GetSymbolsAsync`.

```csharp
var restClient = new PolymarketRestClient();
var symbols = await restClient.PerpsApi.ExchangeData.GetSymbolsAsync();
if (!symbols.Success)
{
    Console.WriteLine(symbols.Error);
    return;
}

var instrument = symbols.Data.FirstOrDefault();
if (instrument == null)
    return;

Console.WriteLine($"{instrument.Symbol}: {instrument.SymbolId}");
var book = await restClient.PerpsApi.ExchangeData.GetOrderBookAsync(instrument.SymbolId, depth: 10);
if (!book.Success)
{
    Console.WriteLine(book.Error);
    return;
}

Console.WriteLine($"Book: {book.Data.Bids.Length} bids, {book.Data.Asks.Length} asks");
```

### Perps authentication and orders

Perps uses a registered proxy key and its API secret. The proxy private key signs
trading operations; the secret authenticates private reads and user streams. Register
a proxy through `PerpsApi.Account.CreateProxyAsync`, using the owner's `signerKey`,
and retain the returned secret. For an existing proxy, configure its key and secret.

Initial proxy creation:
```csharp
var client = new PolymarketRestClient(x =>
{
    x.ApiCredentials = new PolymarketCredentials()
        .WithPerps(null, EthKey.FromPrivateKey("<signing private key>"), EthKey.FromPrivateKey("<proxy private key>"));
});

// Call CreateProxy to register the proxy address used in the credentials and get a secret.
// The secret will be automatically applied if creation is successful,
// for later use the secret should be stored and reused.
var result = await client.PerpsApi.Account.CreateProxyAsync(
    DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(30)); // Expiration time, after which the proxy can not be used anymore

if (!result.Success)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Failed to create proxy: {result.Error}");
    return;
}

// Store the secret for later use
var secret = result.Data.Secret;

var balances = await client.PerpsApi.Account.GetBalancesAsync();
if (!balances.Success)
{
    Console.WriteLine(balances.Error);
    return;
}
Console.WriteLine(balances.Data.Length);
```

With already registered proxy:
```csharp
var previousSecret = "<previously obtained secret>";
var client = new PolymarketRestClient(x =>
{
    x.ApiCredentials = new PolymarketCredentials()
        .WithPerps(previousSecret, EthKey.FromPrivateKey("<signing private key>"), EthKey.FromPrivateKey("<proxy private key>"));
});

var balances = await client.PerpsApi.Account.GetBalancesAsync();
if (!balances.Success)
{
    Console.WriteLine(balances.Error);
    return;
}
Console.WriteLine(balances.Data.Length);
```

### Perps WebSocket subscriptions

```csharp
using Polymarket.Net.Clients;

// Supply a SymbolId discovered with PerpsApi.ExchangeData.GetSymbolsAsync().
if (args.Length != 1 || !long.TryParse(args[0], out var symbolId))
    return;
var socketClient = new PolymarketSocketClient();
var subscription = await socketClient.PerpsApi.ExchangeData.SubscribeToTickerUpdatesAsync(
    symbolId, update => Console.WriteLine($"Ticker: {update.Data}"));
if (!subscription.Success)
{
    Console.WriteLine(subscription.Error);
    return;
}
Console.ReadLine();
await socketClient.UnsubscribeAsync(subscription.Data);
```

Public streams include tickers, trades, order books, candles and statistics. Configure
Perps credentials on the socket client for private subscriptions under
`PerpsApi.Trading` (orders and fills) and `PerpsApi.Account` (balances and portfolio).

### Dependency injection

```csharp
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Polymarket.Net.Interfaces.Clients;

var services = new ServiceCollection();
services.AddPolymarket();
using var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
var restClient = provider.GetRequiredService<IPolymarketRestClient>();
var socketClient = provider.GetRequiredService<IPolymarketSocketClient>();
```

Set `options.ApiCredentials` through `services.AddPolymarket(options => { ... })` for
private access. Both injected clients expose `PredictionApi` and `PerpsApi`.

For client setup, dependency injection and response processing, see the
[documentation](https://cryptoexchange.jkorf.dev/client-libs/getting-started) or the
[examples](Examples), including the [AI-friendly examples](Examples/ai-friendly).

## Shared futures contracts and instrument cache

`restClient.PerpsApi.SharedApi` and `socketClient.PerpsApi.SharedApi` implement
CryptoExchange.Net shared contracts for futures orders, tickers, books, positions
and other supported operations. See `IPolymarketRestClientPerpsSharedApi` and
`IPolymarketSocketClientPerpsSharedApi` for the exact supported interfaces. Concrete
Perps calls use numeric ids. After REST `GetSymbolsAsync()` has populated the symbol
cache, `restClient.PerpsApi.GetSymbolIdByName(name)` and `GetSymbolNameById(id)` can
resolve ids/names.

## Pagination and prediction endpoint routing

Gamma market discovery returns `PolymarketGammaMarket[]`. Keyset variants are
`PredictionApi.ExchangeData.GetMarketsKeysetPaginationAsync(...)` and
`GetEventsKeysetPaginationAsync(...)`. CLOB sampling/simplified calls retain their
own cursor page types. Prediction orders/trades use `PolymarketPage<T>`; positions
use `PolymarketDataPage<PolymarketPosition>` through
`PredictionApi.Trading.GetPositionsAsync(user: address, ...)`.

Additional prediction data calls include
`PredictionApi.ExchangeData.LookupTokensAsync(tokenIds: tokenIds, marketIds: marketIds)`,
`GetOpenInterestAsync(marketIds)` and `GetEventVolumeAsync(eventIds)`.
Perps histories commonly return `PolymarketPaged<T>` with `Data`, `More` and `Cursor`.
Not every history method accepts a cursor; inspect its time/pagination arguments.

## Error handling and retries

Normal API failures are returned via `.Error`. Inspect error type and
`result.Error?.IsTransient` to decide whether a read can be retried. Use bounded
backoff and pass `ct: cancellationToken` where available. Do not blindly retry
order placement: a lost response can leave an accepted order whose state needs
reconciliation. Prediction `PolymarketOrderResult.Success` is separate from
`HttpResult.Success`; Perps order payloads have no `Success` property.

## Local prediction order books and user clients

```csharp
using Polymarket.Net.SymbolOrderBooks;

var orderBook = new PolymarketPredictionSymbolOrderBook("TOKEN_ID");
var start = await orderBook.StartAsync();
if (!start.Success)
{
    Console.WriteLine(start.Error);
    return;
}

try
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Bids: {orderBook.Bids.Count()}, asks: {orderBook.Asks.Count()}");
}
finally
{
    await orderBook.StopAsync();
}
```

Via DI, use `IPolymarketOrderBookFactory.CreatePrediction(tokenId)`. For Perps, use `PolymarketPerpsSymbolOrderBook(symbolId)` or
`IPolymarketOrderBookFactory.CreatePerps(symbolId)`. `AddPolymarket` also registers `IPolymarketUserClientProvider`:
`InitializeUserClient(userIdentifier, credentials, environment)`,
`GetRestClient(userIdentifier)` and `GetSocketClient(userIdentifier)` manage
per-user clients. Inspect provider interfaces for optional overrides/lifetimes.

## Environments and builder options

Configure `options.Environment = PolymarketEnvironment.Live` or `.Testnet`.
Custom environments require all prediction and Perps endpoints:

```csharp
using Polymarket.Net;

var environment = PolymarketEnvironment.CreateCustom(
    name: "custom",
    chainId: 137,
    clobRestAddress: "https://...",
    gammaRestAddress: "https://...",
    dataRestAddress: "https://...",
    clobSocketStreamsAddress: "wss://...",
    sportSocketStreamsAddress: "wss://...",
    polyBoltSocketStreamsAddress: "wss://...",
    perpsRestAddress: "https://...",
    perpsSocketAddress: "wss://...");
```

Builder settings live under `PredictionOptions` and `PerpsOptions`. Set the
appropriate `BuilderCode` to null to disable it. Perps also exposes
`BuilderFeePercentage`; both REST and Perps socket options have Perps builder
settings. When DI configures both clients, inspect `PolymarketOptions.Rest` and
`.Socket` for transport-specific overrides.

## AI-friendly examples

Each file is a standalone console program. Replace credentials/identifiers before
running. The documentation compile test builds these without executing API calls.

|File|Purpose|
|--|--|
|`Examples/ai-friendly/01-market-data-quickstart.cs`|Prediction discovery/search, books and prices|
|`Examples/ai-friendly/02-authentication-and-trading.cs`|Prediction L1/L2, allowance, orders and cancellation|
|`Examples/ai-friendly/03-websocket.cs`|Prediction token/platform/sports/user streams|
|`Examples/ai-friendly/04-di-and-orderbook.cs`|DI, local prediction book, per-user clients|
|`Examples/ai-friendly/05-error-handling.cs`|Result handling, transient read retry, prediction order acceptance|
|`Examples/ai-friendly/06-perps-market-data.cs`|Perps instruments, tickers, books, candles, funding|
|`Examples/ai-friendly/07-perps-authentication-and-trading.cs`|Perps proxy auth, account reads, explicit order inputs and cancellation|
|`Examples/ai-friendly/08-perps-websocket.cs`|Perps public/private streams and cleanup|
